components.name: Send button
components.description: Submits a caller turn from the message field.
components.css: .ds-send{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:41px;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;font-family:"Segoe UI", "Nirmala UI", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:.84rem;font-weight:680;transition:background-color 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease,color 150ms ease;color:#fff;background:var(--primary,#2857bf)}.ds-send:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--primary-hover,#19459f)}.ds-send:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--primary,#2857bf);outline-offset:3px}.ds-send:disabled{opacity:.58}

components.name: Reset button
components.description: Returns the demonstration to its opening order state.
components.css: .ds-reset{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:41px;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;font-family:"Segoe UI", "Nirmala UI", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:.84rem;font-weight:680;transition:background-color 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease,color 150ms ease;background:var(--surface,#fff);border-color:#cfd9e6;color:#30465f}.ds-reset:hover:not(:disabled){background:#eaf0f9;border-color:#9baec5}.ds-reset:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--primary,#2857bf);outline-offset:3px}.ds-reset:disabled{opacity:.58}

components.name: Message field
components.description: Takes typed turns in the selected language.
components.html: <input class="ds-message" type="text" aria-label="Type a message" placeholder="उदा. तांदळाच्या बारा पिशव्या करा">
components.css: .ds-message{min-height:42px;padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid #cbd7e7;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#142336);font-family:"Segoe UI", "Nirmala UI", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:.9rem;caret-color:var(--primary,#2857bf)}.ds-message::placeholder{color:#52657f;opacity:1}.ds-message:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--primary,#2857bf);outline-offset:3px}.ds-message:disabled{background:#f6f8fb}

components.name: Selected navigation link
components.description: Identifies the active section in the navigation rail.
components.html: Order record
components.css: .ds-nav{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:42px;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--rail-strong,#22344e);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #37506f;color:#fff;font-family:"Segoe UI", "Nirmala UI", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:550;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav svg{color:#b5caff}.ds-nav:hover{background:#23354e}.ds-nav:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #6e98f1;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Editable status
components.description: Marks an order line whose dispatch state permits changes.

components.name: Order panel
components.description: Groups the order identity, fulfillment rows, and proposed edit.
components.html:
Order record
DD-2048

Shree Ganesh Kirana
components.css: .ds-order{background:var(--surface,#fff);border:1px solid var(--faint,#dce4ed);border-radius:var(--radius,14px);box-shadow:0 2px 6px #172c4710;color:var(--ink,#142336);font-family:"Segoe UI", "Nirmala UI", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-order-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-height:60px;padding:0 21px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--faint,#dce4ed);font-size:1rem;font-weight:700}.ds-order-title svg{color:#536c8b}.ds-order-body{padding:17px 21px 14px}.ds-order-body strong{font-size:1.43rem;font-weight:740;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-order-body p{margin:3px 0 0;color:var(--muted,#4e6075);font-size:.875rem}

components.name: Pending confirmation
components.description: Shows a proposed quantity before the caller confirms it.
components.html:
Awaiting confirmation
Rice  20 → 10

Confirm the new quantity to update the order.
components.css: .ds-pending{display:grid;gap:5px;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid #ebcf96;border-radius:8px;background:var(--pending-bg,#fff6e4);color:var(--ink,#142336);font-family:"Segoe UI", "Nirmala UI", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-pending-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--pending-ink,#795018);font-size:.81rem}.ds-pending-quantity{font-size:.875rem;font-weight:650}.ds-pending-quantity strong{color:var(--pending-ink,#795018)}.ds-pending p{margin:0;color:var(--muted,#4e6075);font-size:.79rem;line-height:1.45}

components.name: Call control
components.description: Shows the current voice activity and access to the microphone.
components.html:
Listening

Speak naturally in Hindi or Marathi.
components.css: .ds-call{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:94px;padding:13px 15px;border-radius:10px;background:#192a44;color:#fff;font-family:"Segoe UI", "Nirmala UI", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-call-copy{flex:1}.ds-call strong{font-size:.91rem;font-weight:680}.ds-call p{margin:3px 0 0;color:#c0d0e7;font-size:.79rem;line-height:1.4}.ds-call-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:41px;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;font-family:"Segoe UI", "Nirmala UI", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:.84rem;font-weight:680;transition:background-color 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease,color 150ms ease;padding-inline:10px;background:#f4e6ea;color:#762741}.ds-call-button:hover{background:#fff}.ds-call-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #6e98f1;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
A dark navigation rail frames a cool paper workspace. The call panel carries the conversation and controls, and the order record shows the evidence for the agent’s decision. The call stage uses the same navy family as navigation and gives listening and playback a distinct place on the screen.

A confirmed change is visible in the order quantity and the change log. Proposed quantities sit in an amber panel and keep their own visual status.
keyCharacteristics: Navy navigation and call stage with a cool paper workspace.
Compact type, fine borders, and line icons.
Distinct order states with text, color, and icons.

rules.name: The Dispatch State Rule
rules.body: Use amber for a change awaiting confirmation and green for an editable line or a recorded update. Keep each state legible in text.

rules.name: The Order Figure Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for order identifiers and quantity columns.

dos: Do group the draft quantity and the confirmation instruction inside the pending panel.
Do keep turn labels and the language selector visible in the call workspace.
Do preserve the same status words in narrow layouts.
